layer-count.purpose: The count badge keeps a fixed text size independently of --layer-toggle-scale.

vehicle-badge.purpose: Service text stays upright while the calibrated vehicle body and direction arrow follow screen-projected travel, including reverse travel.

motion.name: vehicle-correction
motion.purpose: Small supported ETA revisions blend along the route with smoothstep easing; a fresh unfinished blend continues after ETA until completion, bounded by staleness and expiry.

motion.name: vehicle-reacquire
motion.purpose: A correction above 80m or a backward correction that would reverse travel fades out at the previous position and fades in at the supported revised position.

motion.name: vehicle-heading-smoothing
motion.purpose: Exponential shortest-turn heading smoothing uses a 90ms time constant. Initial placement, reduced motion and active camera movement use the projected tangent directly. Each image rotates by the heading minus its calibrated native front bearing.

motion.name: timetable-snapshot
motion.purpose: Reduced motion distributes opted-in timetable estimates along each route in discrete clock-aligned snapshots. ETA/GPS stays at the latest source-observed position.

components.name: Captioned layer tile
components.description: The dock uses a 0.63 scale from the 88 × 78px baseline, or 0.7 of its former 0.9 scale. Caption and count text retain their frontmatter sizes, and utility targets stay at least 44px. Short Traffic copy retains the full name in its tooltip.
